name: praxic
description: 即物穷理 Praxic —— 以辩证唯物主义方法论为认知内核的 AI 智能体

scripts.dev: concurrently -n py,web -c blue,green "python -m uvicorn praxic.api.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "cd praxic/web && npx vite"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -n py,electron -c blue,magenta "python -m uvicorn praxic.api.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npx electron ."
scripts.electron:build: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-backend-exe.ps1 && cd praxic/web && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && cd ../.. && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js
